brand_identity.name: Grace Music Academy
design_principles: Fusion: Classical Music Aesthetics x Modern SaaS Utility
Emotion: Calm confidence (Paper textures, warm whites)
Content: Data as Sheet Music (Structured, rhythmic, clear)
Zoom: Focus on the student and the schedule
Negative Space: High breathing room, like a well-composed score

headings.usage: Page titles, Hero sections, Major stats

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

usage_rules: Background is Warm Alabaster (#F9F9F7), NOT pure white.
Primary Action Color is Midnight Blue (#2C3E50).
Accent Color (Gold #D4AF37) is used SPARINGLY for 'Paid' status or 'Premium' highlights.
Text is never pure black (#000000), use Deep Charcoal (#1A1A1A).

textures: Noise: Add a subtle noise texture to the background to mimic high-quality paper.
Glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (high blur, slight saturation) for sticky headers.

layout_strategy.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid (Mode B: Control Room). Dense but elegant.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
layout_strategy.alignment: Left-aligned text for readability. Centered only for Hero/Login.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent/10 hover:text-accent rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.style: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.style: bg-white border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md h-10 px-3

status_badges.paid: bg-green-100 text-green-800 border border-green-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
status_badges.unpaid: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
status_badges.pending: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border border-yellow-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

icons.usage: Use for navigation, actions, and status indicators.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #1A1A1A on #F9F9F7. Use APCA checks.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'colors' palette defined above.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn/UI components but override the default styling with the 'components' rules above (especially rounded-full for buttons).
4. LAYOUT: Implement the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' strategy.
5. IMAGES: Use the provided image_urls for the Login page and Empty states.
6. TESTING: Add data-testid to every button, input, and link.
7. FILE EXTENSIONS: Use .js and .jsx as per the project structure.
8. NO TRANSPARENCY: Ensure headers have a solid or blurred background, never transparent over content.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid warm colors or subtle noise.
Avoid 'Inter' font for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Always use named exports for components.
